image_description: A close-up view of a pile of cooked Dungeness crabs displayed in a glass seafood case. The crabs are stacked on top of each other, showing their ventral (underside) surfaces which are cream-colored with orange-red accents on the legs and claws. The background shows a blurred market environment with lighting fixtures and shelving.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are stalked and protrude from anterior carapace margin.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The crabs are piled with their ventral sides facing up or sideways; the dorsal anterior margin where eyes are located is largely occluded by other crabs or the angle of view.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Carapace is smooth and convex displaying purplish-brown to reddish-brown coloration.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The primary visible surface is the ventral side (cream/white). The dorsal carapace coloration is not clearly visible due to the stacking orientation.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface is cream to white.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The underside of the crabs is clearly visible and matches the description of being cream to white/off-white.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Broad oval carapace of substantial edible-crab proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The general shape of the body mass beneath the folded abdomen is consistent with the broad, oval shape of a Dungeness crab.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Carapace displays lighter mottled patterns over purplish-brown base.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: This feature describes the dorsal shell, which is mostly hidden in this pile configuration.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Exoskeleton is hard and calcified with smooth glossy texture.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The shells exhibit specular highlights indicating a smooth, hard, calcified surface typical of cooked crustaceans.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Five pairs of walking legs extend laterally.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Multiple legs are visible extending from the body margins. While counting exactly five pairs per individual is difficult due to overlap, the presence of multiple lateral limbs is confirmed.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: First pair modified into robust claws of unequal size with dark tips.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Robust chelipeds (claws) are visible. They appear to have darker coloration at the tips (reddish-orange vs cream body), consistent with the species.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Claws have smooth outer surface and serrated inner edges.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The resolution and angle do not allow for verification of fine details like serrations on the inner edge of the claws.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Text on the price tags and background signs is illegible and morphologically inconsistent, appearing as gibberish shapes rather than clear characters, a common AI artifact.

artifact_observations.location: Leg intersections in the central pile
artifact_observations.reasoning: Some leg segments appear to merge or fade into adjacent crabs without clear joint definition, suggesting slight structural ambiguity in the dense pile.
